mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_REPORT (ID, PROJECT_ID, REPORT_NUMBER, RISK_LEVEL, GENERATED_TIME, OVERALL_CONCLUSION, AGENT_REVIEW_JSON, REPORT_SNAPSHOT_JSON) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{reportNumber}, #{riskLevel}, #{generatedTime}, #{overallConclusion}, #{agentReviewJson}, #{reportSnapshotJson,jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, PROJECT_ID, REPORT_NUMBER, RISK_LEVEL, GENERATED_TIME, OVERALL_CONCLUSION, AGENT_REVIEW_JSON, REPORT_SNAPSHOT_JSON FROM ( SELECT ID, PROJECT_ID, REPORT_NUMBER, RISK_LEVEL, GENERATED_TIME, OVERALL_CONCLUSION, AGENT_REVIEW_JSON, REPORT_SNAPSHOT_JSON, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY GENERATED_TIME DESC, ID DESC) AS RN FROM PROCUREMENT_REVIEW_REPORT WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ) REPORT_DATA WHERE RN = 1
